headline: Broward Schools Launch Free Menstrual Products Initiative
meta_description: Some Broward schools are beginning to offer free menstrual products to students, removing barriers to education and health.
summary_short: Schools in Broward are taking action to support student health by providing free menstrual products on campus.
body:
Some Broward schools are beginning to offer free menstrual products to students, addressing a practical barrier that can keep young people from attending class.

Period poverty has long been recognized as a hidden challenge affecting school attendance and academic performance. When students lack access to affordable menstrual products, they may miss school days or struggle to concentrate. By providing these essentials freely on campus, Broward schools are removing one significant obstacle to consistent attendance and equal educational opportunity.

The initiative reflects growing awareness among educators that basic health needs directly impact learning. As more districts recognize menstrual equity as part of supporting student wellbeing, programs like Broward's demonstrate a commitment to creating schools where all students can thrive without shame or financial hardship.
quick_facts: Broward schools now offer free menstrual products to students
Initiative removes financial barrier to school attendance
Program supports student health and educational equity
